item: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he resigned.
ING's ~$500m auction of a dozen data-center loans stalled on weak demand; the bank moved to one-by-one sales.
HSBC sold a ~$300m slice of the $18bn Project Jupiter financing in the mid-80s, shortly after Oracle's force-majeure notice (reported 17 Nov).
Blackstone's QTS cut a private data-center debt sale to about $300m, from roughly $800m.
AI-related investment-grade bonds traded about 148 bp over Treasuries, against 77 bp for the rest of the market (BofA).
Reuters: Nebius explored a high-yield bond in September and decided against it in October; also in October it signed a $3.5bn secured loan from Citigroup.
Oracle sent a force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter, its New Mexico Stargate campus.
